messages.content: Good morning. This is Wong, IT Service Manager at Maybank corporate. Customer ID cust-mbb-bank-01. We are evaluating SD-WAN Enterprise Premium for 18 new branch sites across Sabah and Sarawak. Can we first check entitlement eligibility for that profile?
Good morning, Sir Wong. Certainly. I will run the eligibility check for SD-WAN Enterprise Premium against your Maybank account now.

messages.name: check_customer_entitlement_eligibility
messages.content: {"eligibility_id": "elig-mbb-31019", "customer_id": "cust-mbb-bank-01", "eligible": true, "score": 0.92, "requirements_met": ["financial_services_segregation_supported", "geo_coverage_confirmed", "existing_tier_compatible"], "requirements_unmet": ["customer_quota_for_500Mbps_circuits exceeds current pool by 4"], "recommended_adjustments": ["create_new_entitlement_with_quota_uplift"], "valid_until": "2026-06-21T00:00:00+08:00"}

Sir, Maybank is eligible for SD-WAN Enterprise Premium with a confidence score of 0.92. However, your current 500 Mbps circuit quota pool is short by **4 circuits** for the 18 sites. Recommended action: create a new entitlement with quota uplift.

Shall I first list your existing entitlements, then proceed to create the new one?
Yes, list existing first.
Pulling the entitlement list now.

messages.name: list_entitlements
messages.content: {"entitlements": [{"entitlement_id": "ent-mbb-7711", "profile": "sd_wan_enterprise_premium", "status": "active", "sites_allocated": 42, "sites_remaining": 0, "quota_500mbps": {"total": 42, "used": 42}}, {"entitlement_id": "ent-mbb-7820", "profile": "sd_wan_enterprise_standard", "status": "active", "sites_allocated": 110, "sites_remaining": 8, "quota_200mbps": {"total": 118, "used": 110}}], "total": 2}

Sir, Maybank currently has:

- `ent-mbb-7711` - SD-WAN Enterprise Premium, 42/42 fully allocated, 0 remaining.
- `ent-mbb-7820` - SD-WAN Enterprise Standard, 110/118 sites used.

For the new 18 Premium sites we will need a separate entitlement. Shall I create it now with quota_definition for 18 circuits at 500 Mbps each?
Yes, go ahead. 18 circuits, with 25% headroom in case we add more sites in Q3. Profile sd_wan_enterprise_premium.
Creating the new entitlement with 23 quota slots (18 + 25% headroom).

Entitlement `ent-mbb-9012` created in **draft** status with 23-site quota over 36 months. Before activation, I should validate the quota constraints and run a simulation. Shall I do both in parallel, Sir?
Yes please. And while you're at it, pull a dependency graph for the new entitlement so I can see what it touches.
Running all three in parallel, Sir.

Sir, summary of the three checks:

- **Quota validation**: valid, no overlaps, Q2 utilization projected 78%, Q3 91% - headroom sufficient.
- **Deployment simulation**: ETA 72 hours; needs 9 Gbps backbone capacity across KCH, BKI and MYY POPs; monthly cost **RM 91,200**.
- **Dependency graph**: linked to your contract `contract-mbb-2026-44102` and SLA template `sla-financial-bronze`.

The entitlement is ready to be activated. Before that, financial-services compliance typically wants an internal approval. Would you like me to raise one to your governance officer?
Yes, raise it to our compliance officer puan-faridah-mbb. SLA 48 hours. And once she approves I want to activate in batch mode covering all 18 sites.
Certainly, Sir.

Approval `appr-ent-99021` raised to Puan Faridah, due 23 May 10:05 AM. Sir, while we wait, do you want me to draft the change-plan and site allocation upfront so once approval comes through we can hit activate immediately?
Yes plan the change and allocate sites — I'll send you the site list. 6 sites in Sabah (BKI-01 to BKI-06), 12 in Sarawak (KCH-01 to KCH-08, MYY-01 to MYY-04). Equal bandwidth all sites.
Got it, Sir. Drafting the change plan and allocating sites in parallel.

Sir:

- **Change plan `chr-ent-44210`**: 3 phases - Sabah (6 sites), Sarawak Kuching (8 sites), Sarawak Miri (4 sites).
- **Site allocation `alloc-9012-001`**: 18 sites allocated; 5 quota slots remaining for future expansion.

Approval just came in - Puan Faridah approved. Shall I record the decision and proceed with batch activation?
Yes record the decision and activate the batch. Condition: she wants weekly compliance report from us.
Recording decision and triggering batch activation in parallel.

Status: Sabah batch is now running, 0/6 sites complete (just started). Other phases pending. To set up the weekly compliance report condition, shall I schedule a recurring report job and also subscribe your team to activation events?
Yes both. Report every Monday 9am MYT for puan-faridah-mbb plus my email. Subscribe me to activation completed and failed events via Slack to channel #mbb-sd-wan.
Setting up both, Sir.

- **Slack subscription** `sub-mbb-22107` posting to #mbb-sd-wan for completed/failed/status_changed events.

Yes one more thing — pull current usage and quota status so I can share number internally.
Pulling usage and quota now.

- Sites: 18/23 used (5 remaining)

- Current utilisation: 78.3%
- 90-day projection: 91.3% utilisation (21 sites)

We will likely need to plan an uplift in Q3 if the bank adds further branches. Anything else for today?
Last thing — add internal comment to the entitlement noting that we should plan a Q3 quota uplift review.

- New entitlement `ent-mbb-9012` activated (Sabah batch running)
- Compliance officer condition recorded; weekly report scheduled

Anything further, Sir Wong?
No that's all. Thank you very much.
You are most welcome, Sir Wong. Have a good day, and we will be in touch once Sabah batch completes.
